10-01-1370 means 1370-01-10 in ISO format.  
6 weeks = 42 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 47 days.  

1370-01-10 minus 47 days:  
First go to 1370-01-01 (subtract 9 days) → 1370-01-01.  
Remaining 38 days back into previous year (1370 is not a leap year, 1370-01-01 minus 1 day = 1369-12-31).  
1369 is a common year, so December has 31 days.  
From 1369-12-31 subtract 38 days:  
Subtract 31 days → 1369-11-30.  
Remaining 7 days → 1369-11-23.
